title: Ovarian recurrence risk assessment using machine learning, clinical information, and serum protein levels to predict survival in high grade ovarian cancer
summary: The July 25, 2023 Research Square v1 reports ORACLE, an elastic-net score combining clinical factors with serum proteins to stratify time-to-recurrence risk after complete response to chemotherapy for high-grade ovarian cancer. In a discovery cohort of 71 patients, the score separated recurrence outcomes; a prospectively collected independent cohort of 33 patients showed validation TTR HR 4.71 (95% CI 1.75–12.7, p=0.002). The peer-reviewed journal version appeared November 27, 2023 and reports the same study. Validation was single-institution and does not establish clinical utility.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: ORACLE combined age, treatment/surgical factors, stage, CA125 and serum proteins. The discovery cohort included 71 patients; an independently prospectively collected 33-patient cohort had TTR HR 4.71 (95% CI 1.75–12.7, p=0.002) for the reported risk groups.
evidence.unknown: The validation cohort was prospectively collected at the same institution; wider external validity and clinical utility remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: Elastic net combines age, treatment/surgical factors, stage, CA125 and four serum proteins into the ORACLE score; the score is tuned against survival/TTR.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
